tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List every Carragent AI agent: what it does, when it runs, what waits for the owner's approval, what it never does and which tools (Stripe, Google Calendar, HubSpot…) it connects to. Use to answer 'what can Carragent do?'.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent by id (for example collections, scheduling, leads, reviews, report). Use after list_agents or search_carragent to give the details of one agent.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List the plans with monthly and yearly prices in USD cents (plus applicable taxes), their limits, the free-trial length and the refund terms. Use to answer 'how much does Carragent cost?'.

tools.name: search_carragent
tools.description: Keyword search over Carragent's agents and plans, best match first. Use to find the agent for a task, such as 'chase late invoices' or 'confirm appointments'.
